# Toast Message

**Figma:** Toast-Message (page 1579:6872)  
**Import:** `import { useToast } from "@zen/design-system"; // Toast, ToastStack for custom hosts`

Brief, non-blocking feedback about something the user just did or something the system just finished.

## Use it for
- Confirming a completed action ("Changes saved"), ideally with Undo.
- Background results the user may want to act on ("Export ready" → View).

## Use something else for
- Decisions or destructive confirmations → Dialog.
- Persistent, page-level conditions (trial ending, outage) → Alert Banner.
- Field validation → inline error on the Input.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type` | neutral · subtle · info · positive · warning · negative |
| Title / Caption | `title / children` | Body/Base/Bold + Body/Small/Regular |
| Actions | `action {label, onClick, keepOpen}` | one Small button: Overlay Inverse (neutral), Main Tertiary (subtle), Overlay White (colours); pressing it runs onClick, then dismisses the toast (keepOpen: true keeps it, e.g. when the action updates the toast in place) |
| Close | `onClose` | dismiss control |
| Icon | `icon` | type icon, or a custom node |
| Stack | `ToastStack toasts · onDismiss · placement · duration · max · inline` | queue with auto-dismiss (paused on hover/focus), enter/exit + reflow motion, ZenPortal |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/toast.json`.

### Toast
Figma Toast-Message (1579:13276): Corner-Radius/2XLarge surface with Effect/Popover, padding Medium/Large, gap Medium; the Body groups the Title/Caption stack (gap 3XSmall) with the action (gap XSmall). Subtle is the Popover surface with a 1px OUTSIDE Border/Popover/Subtle stroke.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"neutral" \| "subtle" \| "info" \| "positive" \| "warning" \| "negative"` | — |  |
| `status` | `"success" \| "error" \| "warning" \| "info"` | — | **Deprecated:** Use type: success → positive, error → negative (warning and info are the same).  |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Title (Body/Base/Bold). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Caption (Body/Small/Regular). |
| `icon` | `boolean \| IconName \| ReactNode` | `true` | `true` (default) shows the type's icon, `false` hides it; an icon name or a node replaces it. |
| `action` | `{ label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; keepOpen?: boolean }` | — | Figma Actions: one Small button. Pressing it runs `onClick`, then dismisses the toast through `onClose` (which useToast and ToastStack provide), so Undo or View never leaves a stale toast. `keepOpen: true` leaves it open, e.g. when the action updates this toast in place; calling dismiss(id) in `onClick` as well is harmless. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Shows the close control (icon-x-small-line). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the close control. Default: the locale's “Dismiss”. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### ToastStack
Toast queue with motion: a new toast rises in from the screen edge while its row opens (Slow, emphasized); a leaving toast fades and shrinks in place (Fast), then its row closes (Base) so the others slide over. Fixed stacks portal into a shared layer in the ZenPortal container; aria-live is on each Toast.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toasts` (required) | `ToastItem[]` | — |  |
| `onDismiss` (required) | `(id: ToastItem["id"]) => void` | — | Called when a toast times out, its close button is pressed or its action runs (unless `action.keepOpen`); remove it from `toasts`. It may be called again for an id already removed (an action that dismisses itself): ignore that. |
| `placement` | `"bottom-center" \| "bottom-right" \| "top-center" \| "top-right"` | `"bottom-center"` |  |
| `duration` | `number` | `5000` | Default auto-dismiss (ms). Toasts with an action get +3s. Each toast counts down from when it appears; timers pause while the stack is hovered or focused. |
| `max` | `number` | `3` | Most toasts shown at once; older ones are dismissed. |
| `inline` | `boolean` | `false` | Render in place (e.g. inside a demo card) instead of the fixed viewport layer. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of every toast's close button (a toast's own `closeLabel` wins). Default: the locale's “Dismiss”. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### ToastProvider
Owns the toast queue and renders one ToastStack. ZenProvider already includes it (outermost provider), so apps only call useToast(); render ToastProvider yourself only outside a ZenProvider.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `"bottom-center" \| "bottom-right" \| "top-center" \| "top-right"` | — |  |
| `duration` | `number` | — | Default auto-dismiss in ms (toasts with an action get +3s). |
| `max` | `number` | — | Most toasts on screen at once. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface ToastItem extends Omit<ToastProps, "onClose" | "className"> { id: string | number; duration?: number | null; }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Reach the action or close button |
| Enter / Space | Run the action / dismiss |

## ✅ Do
- Show toasts with `const { toast } = useToast(); toast({ title: "Invite sent" })`; ZenProvider hosts the stack, so no ToastStack state is needed.
- Keep it to one short title and at most one line of description.
- Offer a single action, and prefer Undo for actions that change data.
- Let the action close its toast: Undo/View runs onClick and then dismisses it, so onClick needs no dismiss(id) (calling it anyway is harmless); set action.keepOpen only when the action updates the toast in place.
- Use Neutral for everyday confirmations (sent, saved, copied); reserve colours for status that matters (Positive when success is the news, e.g. a payment went through).
- Auto-dismiss informational toasts (about 5s, longer with an action) and pause on hover/focus.
- Show one toast at a time for the same event; replace, don't stack duplicates.
- Outside a ZenProvider (or for a second, custom host), render a ToastStack yourself: keep the list in state and remove items in onDismiss — it keeps timing, pause-on-hover and motion consistent.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a toast to ask a question or confirm a destructive action.
- Don't put essential information only in a toast. It disappears.
- Don't show more than one action, or links inside the text.
- Don't use Negative for errors the user must fix in a form; show them inline.
- Don't ask a question or exceed ~60 characters in the title (harness: toast/concise).

## Accessibility
- role=status (polite); negative/urgent toasts use role=alert.
- The close control is a labelled button; focus is never moved into a toast automatically.
- Give auto-dismissing toasts enough time: at least 5s, paused on hover and focus.

## Content
- Title states the outcome in past tense ("Project published"); action is a verb ("Undo", "View").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toast/needs-title` | error | A toast states its outcome in a title. | `zen-allow-toast-title: <reason>` |
| `toast/concise` | warn | Toast titles state an outcome in ≤ 60 characters and never ask a question. | `zen-allow-toast-copy: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/action-without-handler` | warn | Screens, examples and templates (apps too since 2026-10-07; component source is skipped): every action does something when pressed. Flags a `Button` or `<button>` without onClick / href / type="submit" (IconButton: icon-button/needs-action), an action object ({ icon, label }) in leading, trailing, action, primaryAction, secondaryAction, subAction or actions without onClick, and pressable items whose list has no onSelect / onNavigate / onItemClick / onValueChange. Documented defaults pass: Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel and BottomSheet actions close the overlay; a Menu opens from its trigger. Apps are not judged. | `zen-allow-action-handler: <reason>` |
